about_the_game:
Blinding beams of light ravage without restraint. Under the desperate assault of the "Mingzhu Tower," the people of the "Snow-house" gradually vanish...

Where the beams reach, no one from the Snow-house survives. As time slips away, the figures of the Snow-house people fade little by little...

This city is enduring an ordeal. The surviving Snow-house civilians flee to Ye-Luo Academy for refuge, but how much can the academy truly bear for them under such overwhelming, era-crushing strikes? At this critical moment, Ma Luoqian steps forward. As always, she lifts the banner of Ye-Luo Academy and declares to the scholars:

"My academy, my call!"

Now, with the strength of all the Snow-house people, the scholars, and exiled academies gathered within you—what decisions will you make? In the face of the Mingzhu Tower's attacks, will you choose to surrender? Or will you fight to the end alongside your companions, colleagues, and classmates, standing by the choices you've made?

Character Introduction

About 《Eastern Mingzhu Tower》

Eastern Mingzhu Tower is a multi-ending tower defense + bishoujo AVG game. Set in a modern world filled with magic, you play as the president of Ye-Luo Academy, Ma Luoqian, guiding the academy through hardships and challenges. Under the shadow of the global catastrophe, the "Mingzhu Tower," the decisions made by you and Ye-Luo Academy may even shape the future of the entire world.

Currently, You Can Look Forward To:

  • Various types of enemies and defensive towers

  • Dynamic, physics-based battle scenes

  • Cheat-style tower defense—where you can join the attack yourself!

  • 2 optional main character routes

  • 2 romanceable side characters

  • 100,000+ words of text (at minimum)

  • 4 branching endings

  • ...

Notes Before Playing:

  • Some dialogues include relatively niche Chinese internet memes.

  • Inspiration for certain characters comes from Chinese online memes.

  • This story is entirely fictional; please do not associate it with reality.
